name: coolto-local-agent
description: Local single-agent runtime for the Coolto desktop app

scripts.pdf:export: npm run desktop:build && esbuild src/cli/pdf-export-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=out/cli/pdf-export-entry.cjs && electron out/cli/pdf-export-entry.cjs
scripts.cli:electron: npm run desktop:build && esbuild src/cli/electron-main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --external:@napi-rs/keyring --external:pdfjs-dist --outfile=out/cli/electron-main.cjs && electron out/cli/electron-main.cjs
scripts.check: npm run check:resume-template && npm run check:source-lines && npm run typecheck && npm run desktop:typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run desktop:build
scripts.package:mac: npm run desktop:build && npx electron-builder --mac --dir && codesign --force --deep --sign - --options runtime --entitlements build/entitlements.mac.plist dist-electron/mac-arm64/Coolto.app
